author_or_account: UN Office for Digital and Emerging Technologies
title: AI Divide Widens: Global Governance Efforts Emerge
discussion_signal: The post frames the AI divide as a capacity and governance problem, not merely a technology-access gap, and points to representation across regions and proposed support for countries building applications, datasets, and institutional capability. This links digital inequality to demographic and development policy choices.
linked_research_question: How do digital capacity, data ownership, and governance shape demographic development choices and unequal technological futures?
limits: Proposed funding and governance mechanisms are not outcomes
